title: Home-Place Deed (24 Mar 1682)
author: John Greene of Quidnessett
notes: Joan named as wife; 30s annuity to John then 'after his decease to Joane Greene his wife' (Worth 1921 abstract pp.173-174); F.L. Greene 1894 p.10: 'as long as their father or mother should live'. John alone signs. The 'or to her mother if she survive' wording is UNVERIFIED — in neither source; see contradictions/mother-clause-wording.md
